_comment: Pinned upstream Biomni revision and the model revision this project targets. The Biomni source itself is NOT vendored: clone it and check out this commit (see README). external/ is otherwise gitignored.

model.notes: Weights ship in FP32 (131 GB). --dtype bfloat16 must be passed explicitly; see DECISIONS.md D-03.

benchmark.notes: Every row is split=val; there is no held-out split. See DECISIONS.md D-02.
